class.name: NetwQuantize
class.brief_description: Compresses a value into fewer bits, losing some precision.

method.name: _bit_width
method.description: Return how many bits each integer of a [param type] value uses.

method.name: _decode
method.description: Return the [param type] value rebuilt from [param codes], the [method _stride] integers from [method _encode].

method.name: _encode
method.description: Return integer number [param element] of [param value]. It must fit in [method _bit_width] bits, or the whole update is dropped.

method.name: _max_error
method.description: Return the largest error compression can add to a [param type] value. Keep [member NetwPredictionHandle.divergence_epsilon] above it, or compression alone causes corrections.

method.name: _stride
method.description: Return how many integers a [param type] value is split into, such as [code]1[/code] for a [float] and [code]2[/code] for a [Vector2].

method.name: _supports_type
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when this quantizer can compress a [param type] value.

method.name: bit_width
method.description: Calls [method _bit_width]. [method total_bits] is the size of the whole value.

method.name: is_same_layout
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param other] has the same class, script and settings, so each can read what the other writes.

method.name: total_bits
method.description: Returns the bits of a whole [param type] value, [method bit_width] times [method stride].
